title: Exploring the effect of the LnIII/LnII redox potential on C–F activation and on oxidation of some lanthanoid organoamides

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: tetranuclear europium(III) mixed fluoride/oxide cluster toluene solvate

material_class.structural_family: tetranuclear Eu4 mixed fluoride/oxide cluster with two eight-coordinate and two seven-coordinate Eu(III) centres

synthesis.procedure: The precursor [Eu(LEt)2(thf)2] was first prepared by an RTP reaction: europium powder (0.32 g, 1.3 mmol), Hg(C6F5)2 (0.62 g, 1.2 mmol) and LEtH (0.62 g, 2.3 mmol) were reacted as in the bulk [Eu(LEt)2(thf)2] synthesis (stirred in thf). The mixture was filtered and the solvent was removed under vacuum. Toluene (5 mL) was added and the solution was left exposed to light. The colour gradually changed to red/purple. Over time, red/purple crystals precipitated together with a smaller number of orange crystals of [Eu4(LEt)6F2O2]·PhMe, which were hand-picked for X-ray crystallography. A related experiment placing a thf solution of [Eu(LEt)2(thf)2] under a halogen lamp for 6 h likewise changed the colour from bright yellow to purple.

reagents.name: [Eu(LEt)2(thf)2]
reagents.role: isolated precursor subjected to light-induced C–F activation
reagents.amount: prepared in situ from the RTP mixture above

synthesis.temperature: ambient (light exposure); related halogen-lamp experiment 6 h in thf
synthesis.time: over time (days) for crystallization after light exposure; 6 h under halogen light in thf for colour change
synthesis.vessel_or_method: redox-transmetallation/protolysis (RTP) followed by light-induced C–F activation; halogen lamp used in a related thf experiment
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filter RTP mixture, remove solvent under vacuum, add toluene (5 mL), leave exposed to light; orange crystals of [Eu4(LEt)6F2O2]·PhMe hand-picked from a mixture with poorly diffracting red/purple crystals
synthesis.yield: not reported (minor orange crystals hand-picked from a mixed precipitate)

properties.summary: No magnetic or optical measurements are reported for the isolated [Eu4(LEt)6F2O2]·PhMe crystals. Related UV-vis data (λmax = 521 nm) refer to a light-activated thf solution of the Eu(II) precursor, not to the cluster.
